# The island: the cloud ground round the greens (gently lumpy, deleted under the felt) and the
# lumpy cloud skirt hanging under its rim (a superellipse |x/19.4|^8 + |z/13.5|^8 = 1 tapering
# down; the faces looking away from the camera deleted). Generated by make_course.py.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
material new Puff --base-color 0.6392 0.7529 0.9020 --no-slot
material new Skirt --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
material new SkirtPuff --base-color 0.6392 0.7529 0.9020 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Ground --size 1 --x-subdivisions 198 --y-subdivisions 139 --location 0 0 0
scale 39.6000 27.8000 1
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 -0.0000 0
apply --location
material assign Cloud
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.035 * sin(pos.x * 1.7 + 0.4) * sin(pos.y * 1.3) + 0.03 * sin(pos.x * 0.6 - pos.y * 0.9))"
mode edit
select face where "pow(abs(pos.x) / 19.496999999999996, 8) + pow(abs(pos.y) / 13.567499999999999, 8) > 1 || (pos.x > -15.080 && pos.x < -12.120 && (0 - pos.y) > -8.400 && (0 - pos.y) < -5.420) || (pos.x > -13.916 && pos.x < -13.284 && (0 - pos.y) > -11.260 && (0 - pos.y) < -8.640) || (pos.x > -15.080 && pos.x < -12.120 && (0 - pos.y) > -12.230 && (0 - pos.y) < -11.500) || (pos.x > -11.880 && pos.x < -7.220 && (0 - pos.y) > -12.230 && (0 - pos.y) < -7.320) || (pos.x > -4.780 && pos.x < 4.780 && (0 - pos.y) > -9.780 && (0 - pos.y) < -7.020) || (pos.x > 7.220 && pos.x < 16.780 && (0 - pos.y) > -10.880 && (0 - pos.y) < -5.920) || (pos.x > 7.220 && pos.x < 16.780 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.280 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.280) || (pos.x > -4.780 && pos.x < -1.120 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.180 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.180) || (pos.x > 0.520 && pos.x < 4.780 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.180 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.180) || (pos.x > -16.780 && pos.x < -7.220 && (0 - pos.y) > -2.880 && (0 - pos.y) < 2.880) || (pos.x > -16.780 && pos.x < -7.220 && (0 - pos.y) > 5.720 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.080) || (pos.x > -4.780 && pos.x < 4.780 && (0 - pos.y) > 8.920 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.280) || (pos.x > 1.720 && pos.x < 4.780 && (0 - pos.y) > 5.320 && (0 - pos.y) < 8.680) || (pos.x > 7.220 && pos.x < 16.780 && (0 - pos.y) > 5.520 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.280)"
delete only-faces
select face where "sin(pos.x * 0.83 + 1.3) * sin(pos.y * 1.07 - 0.4) + 0.6 * sin(pos.x * 0.31 + pos.y * 0.47) > 0.95"
material assign Puff
mode object
add mesh grid --name Skirt --size 1 --x-subdivisions 220 --y-subdivisions 7 --location 0 0 0
material assign Skirt
attribute set position "vec((19.4 * cos(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001)) / pow(abs(cos(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001))) + 0.000001, 0.75) * ((1 - 0.78 * pow((0.5 - pos.y), 1.5)) * (1 + 0.045 * abs(sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001) * 23 + (0.5 - pos.y) * 3)) + 0.03 * abs(sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001) * 9 - (0.5 - pos.y) * 5))))), (13.5 * sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001)) / pow(abs(sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001))) + 0.000001, 0.75) * ((1 - 0.78 * pow((0.5 - pos.y), 1.5)) * (1 + 0.045 * abs(sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001) * 23 + (0.5 - pos.y) * 3)) + 0.03 * abs(sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001) * 9 - (0.5 - pos.y) * 5))))), (0.05 - 4.2 * pow((0.5 - pos.y), 1.2) + 0.25 * sin(((pos.x + 0.5) * 6.283185 + 0.0001) * 17) * (0.5 - pos.y)))"
mode edit
select all
normals recalculate
select face where "normal.y > 0.3 || normal.z > 0.5"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor(pos.z / 0.9 + (pos.x + pos.y + 100) / 2.1) % 3) == 0"
material assign SkirtPuff
mode object
select Ground Skirt
shade flat
export island.glb
